sources.name: Campus fellowship offices
sources.note: Nearly every university has an office whose whole job is this, and their public pages are the best-maintained lists anywhere. Start with the schools people on this platform actually attend.

sources.name: Listed by the people who run it
sources.note: A host profile files their own program through fellowships.html. Arrives pending, always.

sources.name: Idealist
sources.note: Broad nonprofit listings; fellowships sit among jobs and internships, so it needs filtering.

sources.name: Opportunity Desk
sources.note: Heavier on international and youth programs than most U.S. directories.

sources.name: ProFellow
sources.note: The database the owner named first. Work it by hand or with permission — their listings are their work product.

sources.name: The desk
sources.note: Added by Equity Uprise directly, usually because somebody asked for it.

fellowships.title: Congressional Innovation Fellowship
fellowships.summary: Places technologists inside congressional offices as staff, so that the people writing technology law have somebody in the room who has built the thing.
fellowships.duration: Several months to a year, by track
fellowships.eligibility: For people with a technical background; tracks differ by career stage.
fellowships.deadline_note: Multiple tracks with separate calendars — confirm which one fits before the date matters.

fellowships.title: Coro Fellowship in Public Affairs
fellowships.summary: A full-time apprenticeship in how a city actually works: participants rotate through government, business, labor, nonprofits and political campaigns rather than studying any one of them.
fellowships.eligibility: Open to people early in their careers; a degree is not required by every site.
fellowships.deadline_note: Cycles open and close annually — confirm on the program's own page.

fellowships.title: Echoing Green Fellowship
fellowships.summary: Seed funding and support for people starting an organization to solve a problem they have lived with, rather than joining one that already exists.
fellowships.eligibility: For founders at an early stage of building an organization.
fellowships.deadline_note: Applications open on an annual cycle — confirm on the program's own page.

fellowships.title: Emerging Reporters Program
fellowships.summary: A stipend and mentorship for student journalists from backgrounds underrepresented in investigative reporting.
fellowships.deadline_note: Annual cycle — confirm on ProPublica's own page.

fellowships.title: Emerson Collective Fellowship
fellowships.summary: Support for people already deep in a body of work on education, immigration, climate or criminal justice, rather than for people starting one.
fellowships.eligibility: By application and, in some cycles, by nomination.
fellowships.deadline_note: Cycles are irregular — confirm the program is open before planning around it.

fellowships.title: Fulbright U.S. Student Program
fellowships.summary: Study, research or teach abroad for a year on a U.S. government grant. The largest and best-documented route out of the country for people early in their careers.
fellowships.eligibility: U.S. citizens holding a bachelor's degree by the start of the grant.
fellowships.deadline_note: A long annual cycle with campus deadlines months before the national one — start early.

fellowships.title: Harry S. Truman Scholarship
fellowships.summary: A graduate funding award for undergraduates who intend to spend their careers in public service, with a summer institute and a network that keeps working long after the money is spent.
fellowships.eligibility: U.S. undergraduates in their third year, nominated by their institution.
fellowships.deadline_note: Nominations run through campus fellowship offices on a fixed annual calendar — confirm both dates.

fellowships.title: Health Leadership Fellows
fellowships.summary: A Connecticut program that trains people to work on health equity in the state — the closest thing on this list to home for the Bridgeport cohort.
fellowships.eligibility: For people working on health and equity in Connecticut.
fellowships.deadline_note: Runs in cohorts rather than continuously — confirm whether one is open.

fellowships.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
fellowships.summary: Full funding for graduate study at Stanford in any department, built around a leadership program that runs alongside the degree.
fellowships.duration: Up to the length of the degree
fellowships.eligibility: Applicants must also apply to a Stanford graduate program.
fellowships.deadline_note: Two applications with two calendars — confirm both.

fellowships.title: Marshall Scholarship
fellowships.summary: Graduate study anywhere in the United Kingdom, funded by the British government, for Americans.
fellowships.eligibility: U.S. citizens with a bachelor's degree and a strong academic record.
fellowships.deadline_note: Campus endorsement precedes the national deadline — confirm both.

fellowships.title: Mozilla Fellowship
fellowships.summary: Support for people working on the health of the internet: privacy, platform accountability, and the public interest in how technology gets built.
fellowships.eligibility: Open to technologists, researchers, advocates and policy people.
fellowships.deadline_note: Runs intermittently rather than every year — confirm the program is open before planning around it.

fellowships.title: New America Fellows Program
fellowships.summary: Support for writers, journalists and researchers working on a book or a major project about American public problems.
fellowships.eligibility: Open to writers and researchers; no advanced degree requirement stated.
fellowships.deadline_note: Cycles vary by fellowship track — confirm on the program's own page.

fellowships.title: Report for America Corps
fellowships.summary: Places reporters in local newsrooms to cover beats that stopped being covered — statehouses, county government, the meetings where the decisions in these topics actually get made.
fellowships.eligibility: For working journalists; newsrooms and reporters apply separately.
fellowships.deadline_note: Reporter and newsroom calendars differ — confirm the one that applies to you.

fellowships.title: Rhodes Scholarship
fellowships.summary: Graduate study at Oxford, fully funded. The oldest of the international awards and the one with the heaviest campus-endorsement process.
fellowships.eligibility: Age and degree requirements apply and vary by country of application.
fellowships.deadline_note: National deadlines differ by constituency, and campus endorsement comes first.
